title: 拿錯了
subject: taking the food delivery left outside your door with someone else's name on it
caption: Mandarin indie band power pop, fast and bright. Two jangly electric guitars doubled wide with light overdrive, drums played fast and hard with an open snare, bass played with a pick riding eighth notes, handclaps on the chorus, one guitar solo of four bars. Bright and punchy mix with the guitars forward and plenty of top end. Young male voice, rushed and slightly shouted, cramming syllables against the beat, gang backing vocals on the hook. 168 BPM, E major. Comic guilt with confessional energy. No ballad section, no synth, no autotune, no trap drums, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - jangly guitars and fast drums]

[Verse 1]
外送放在門口 名字不是我
我看了三秒 我拿進來了
我發誓我本來只是要看一下那是什麼
結果是我最想吃的那一家

[Pre-Chorus]
樓上有人在找 我聽到腳步聲
我把袋子藏到廚房 像在藏證據

[Chorus]
我拿錯了 我沒有錯拿
這兩句不一樣 我知道
我吃完了 我洗了碗 我洗得超乾淨
好像洗乾淨就沒發生

[Verse 2]
隔天我在電梯遇到七樓那個人
他跟我說「昨天我外送被偷」
我說「真的假的 好扯」
我真的這樣說 我聽到我自己這樣說

[Chorus]
我拿錯了 我沒有錯拿
這兩句不一樣 我知道
我吃完了 我洗了碗 我洗得超乾淨
但我現在還記得那個味道

[Bridge - guitar solo]

[Verse 3]
我點了一份一樣的 放在他門口
沒有寫名字 他可能也拿進去了
那我們就一樣了 我這樣跟自己講
講完我也不太信

[Outro - cut]
電梯到了 我先出去
[Song ends abruptly]
